title: 12 Best Night Markets in Abu Dhabi
description: Explore Abu Dhabi's best night markets and evening hotspots for delicious street food, unique crafts, and vibrant atmospheres. Discover top picks for every budget and taste.

places.name: Yas Bay Waterfront
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy fresh seafood from Asia Asia or gourmet burgers from Lock, Stock & Barrel, paired with a refreshing mocktail.

places.name: Umm Al Emarat Park (Seasonal Markets)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try an authentic Emirati Luqaimat (sweet dumplings) or a gourmet burger from one of the rotating food trucks.

places.name: Al Qana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Savor authentic Italian pizza from Otoro or explore Mediterranean flavors at The Bridge Wellness Hub & Kitchen.

places.name: Marsa Al Bateen Marina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy fresh grilled fish from a local seafood restaurant or traditional Arabic mezze at one of the waterfront cafes.

places.name: Hudayriat Island (Marsana Beach)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Experiment with different food truck offerings, from gourmet hotdogs and burgers to specialty coffees and ice cream.

places.name: Al Mina Fish Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pick out your favorite fresh fish or shellfish, have it grilled with local spices, and enjoy with rice and salad.

places.name: World Trade Center Souk
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy traditional Arabic coffee and dates, or a light meal from one of the contemporary cafes within the souk.

places.name: Sheikha Fatima Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a gourmet coffee, a pastry, or a light wrap from one of the park's vibrant kiosks.

places.name: The Galleria Al Maryah Island (Promenade)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in a steak from LPM Restaurant & Bar or explore Mediterranean flavors at Zuma, followed by a stroll along the water.

places.name: Mamsha Al Saadiyat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Savor seafood at White Elephant or enjoy a vibrant Italian meal at Antonia, accompanied by the sounds of the waves.

places.name: Reem Island (Various Food Kiosks/Promenades)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a specialty coffee and a cronut, or try a variety of snacks from the rotating kiosks.

places.name: Mina Cruise Terminal (Seasonal Pop-ups)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try unique international street food dishes from visiting vendors, or artisanal snacks from local businesses.
